title: Registered real-data A/B/C block — FRED monthly, 2008 GFC dated hypothesis

dated_hypothesis.label: 2008 Global Financial Crisis (2008-09 → 2009-06)
dated_hypothesis.rationale: The most documented macro regime transition in the FRED span. t1=2008-09 (Lehman), t2=2009-06, t*=2008-09. Frozen BEFORE running the detector.

proxy_spec.note: Column mapping is fixed by dataset_A.cols; no proxy is chosen after seeing results.

controls.B_stable: pre-onset segment of A (rows t < t1) — quiescent regime, expected NO detection
controls.C_placebo: cyclic shift of A by N // shift_divisor — autocorrelation preserved, onset alignment destroyed, expected NO detection

oos.split: train indices < t_star, test indices >= t_star

aggregation_rule: REAL_BLOCK_CONFIRMED iff (A fires a localized transition inside [t1,t2]±onset_tolerance) AND (B stable + external silent) AND (C placebo silent) AND (IAAFT surrogate p < alpha) AND (pre-t* OOS directional skill). Else REAL_BLOCK_REJECTED. REAL_BLOCK_INDETERMINATE if the run is undecidable.
honest_expectation: FRED is the HARD case: exploratory analysis already shows ROBUST_NEGATIVE (multiverse 0/27) and an IAAFT surrogate p = 1.0. It is registered here precisely because it is the anti-cherry-pick choice — the apparatus and the frozen rule are the deliverable, not a manufactured positive. A REJECTED verdict is reported at equal status to a confirmation.
amendment_policy: Any change to dataset, hypothesis window, proxy/normalization, criteria, benchmark panel, surrogate config or aggregation rule requires a NEW dated registration. This file is append-only by supersession.
